feeds.title: Exit Planning Institute Blog
feeds.description: The Exit Planning Institute (EPI) thrives as an educational powerhouse. Fueled by dedicated staff and industry luminaries, they champion professional advisors with top-tier content and ongoing support. EPI, with over 5,000 certified CEPAs, leads the exit planning domain globally, steadfast in its mission. Their blog disseminates invaluable insights, trends, and resources for advisors and business owners alike.

feeds.title: MPN Incorporated
feeds.description: Awake at 2 o'clock? offers a rich tapestry of articles catering to business owners. Covering Entrepreneurship, Leadership, Sales and Marketing, Exit Planning, and insights into the American business landscape, it delves into triumphs and challenges. With diverse perspectives, it serves as a valuable resource for navigating the entrepreneurial journey.

feeds.title: Acquire Blog » Exit Planning
feeds.description: Acquire.com facilitates startup acquisitions effortlessly. With seasoned experts and cutting-edge technology, they streamline sales within 30 days. Their platform unifies the buying and selling process, fostering trust and transparency. Acquire.com's mission is to simplify startup acquisitions, empowering clients to focus on their sales journey.

feeds.title: Exit Strategies Group Blog
feeds.description: Exit Strategies specializes in managing sales for family and closely-held businesses up to $100 million in revenue. They excel in sell-side representation, recapitalizations, and management buyouts, maximizing value and ensuring confidentiality. Their full-service business valuation firm offers independent valuations for various purposes. Trusted by diverse stakeholders, their seasoned team brings valuable insights and expertise. Access articles and insights on California business valuation and sales.

feeds.title: Excel Legacy Group » Exit Strategy
feeds.description: Excel Legacy Group offers top-tier ESOP services, guiding clients through establishment, financing, and execution. Their team of experts assists with exit strategies, business transitions, and succession planning, ensuring seamless transitions and empowering clients to achieve their ESOP goals.

feeds.title: Blue Sky Exit Planning Services Blog
feeds.description: Blue Sky, led by founder Joe Gitto, offers insightful blog content on buying and selling businesses. Their Four four-phase process simplifies exit planning, ensuring maximum value and security. Business owners gain clarity on the process, enhancing business value and securing financial stability for their families.

feeds.title: Exit Strategy Birmingham Blog
feeds.description: ProExit instils confidence in small business owners, offering clarity on their business worth. Their goal is to level the playing field, guiding owners through the exit process. Identifying areas for improvement, they provide strategic solutions. The Value Builder System, a free transformative tool, primes businesses for sale seamlessly.

feeds.title: Strategic Exit Partners Blog
feeds.description: Strategic Exits Partners, a boutique tech M&A advisory, serves entrepreneurs and angel investors exclusively. With seasoned advisors rooted in tech, they optimize M&A transactions. Their expertise spans diverse tech domains, ensuring comprehensive understanding and depth. Access their M&A blog for insights on exit strategies, timing, and valuation. With a focus on founders, they redefine value in tech exits.

feeds.title: Final Ascent Blog » Exit Planning
feeds.description: Final Ascent empowers and guides underserved lower-middle market business owners. Recognizing their challenges, they offer unparalleled support and expertise. With firsthand experience, they serve as a guiding light, ensuring owners navigate the selling journey confidently and successfully.

feeds.title: Vistage Research Center » Exit Planning
feeds.description: Vistage, the globe's largest executive coaching organization for small and midsize enterprises, boasts 65+ years of empowering CEOs and executives. Their success stems from confidential peer advisory groups and executive coaching, offering a holistic approach to tackling tough challenges.

feeds.title: The Exit Strategy Blog
feeds.description: Kerry Boulton, founder and CEO of The Exit Strategy Group, emerged from retirement in 2013. She aids CEOs and business owners in maximizing value and crafting systematic exit plans. Kerry views exit planning as a dynamic process, guiding owners to financial freedom and successful transitions. Access her wealth of tips and advice on selling small businesses effectively.

feeds.title: Exit Advisors Blog
feeds.description: Exit Advisors offers tailored, collaborative solutions for clients, setting them apart from traditional M&A firms. Founded by seasoned entrepreneurs, they provide intimate, hands-on service with access to industry tools. Their partners bring firsthand experience in transactions, offering insights from both seller and buyer perspectives.

feeds.title: Destined Blog » Exit Options
feeds.description: Destined specializes in guiding business owners through strategic sales journeys. As premier brokers, they offer personalized M&A advisory services, ensuring successful and rewarding exits. With deep market insights, their experienced team empowers clients to navigate the process confidently. Explore exit options and transition management through their informative blog.

feeds.title: Maus Strategic Planning Blog
feeds.description: Maus, the premier all-in-one platform, revolutionizes strategic, financial, and exit planning. Their innovative software empowers SMBs and advisors with effective strategies. Grounded in respect, trust, and honesty, they prioritize client value over sales, embodying genuine support.

feeds.title: Quantive Blog » Exit Planning
feeds.description: Quantive, a veteran-owned firm, specializes in M&A Advisory, valuations, and value growth consulting. With 15+ years of experience in the lower middle market, they've amassed invaluable insights. Their journey bears scars and wisdom, shaping them into a best-in-class advisory firm.
